meaning.text: The variant changes the day on which God completes the work; both forms place rest on the seventh.
meaning.label: DISPUTED

possible_reason.text: Tov argues that “sixth” eases the apparent problem of God working on the Sabbath.
possible_reason.label: SCHOLARLY INTERPRETATION

assessment.text: Tov favors the more difficult “seventh” here. This is an attributed judgment, not a rule that MT is always earlier.
assessment.label: SCHOLARLY INTERPRETATION

traditional.text: Rashi’s discussion includes the idea that Sabbath rest itself completed creation.
traditional.label: TRADITIONAL INTERPRETATION
